statement: The seed leader-readiness join gate is sealed at a reachable base with a bounded authoritative refresh that preserves the parent request budget and emits typed attribution: stale cache with fresh authority admits, genuine leaderlessness or unavailable/exhausted authority remains rejected, and cache-hit and probe paths perform no authoritative reads.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The refresh must be aggregate-bounded (batched or capped across missing partitions), never unbounded per-partition fan-out per join request — CL-012 readiness-read-amplification class; CL-012 guard tests must stay green.

The refresh must be bounded-time and FAIL-OPEN to the current reject when authoritative reads are unavailable (formation circularity: during formation the authoritative path may itself lack the missing leaders — never block or crash the gate).
doneWhen emitter: extend scripts/run-placement-affinity-scenarios.js with this scenario's guard files as part of the quest.
